findings.title: Pointer-pair cleanup assertion replaces the original input-delivery failure
findings.evidence: When mouse.click throws before both pointer events arrive, entityPrepared is already true. The finally call invokes the actual finishEntityClick complete-pair assertion and throws a new AssertionError. The original input-delivery error is neither propagated nor retained as cause, so the batch failure record loses its actual primary cause. Executed both frozen actual function bodies with a rejected delivery and empty observed event list; all picker restoration succeeded, yet the original error was replaced.
findings.requiredRepair: Always restore and log the pointer observer, but preserve the primary preparation/click error and separately retain any cleanup or event-validation error. Require the complete pair on the normal successful dispatch path; failed/partial dispatch must keep its original cause and recorded partial events. Add actual-source-body coverage for a rejected click and a rejected click plus cleanup/diagnostic failure.

reproduction.scope: Frozen source function bodies, bounded plain Node only; no browser or profile.

positiveAssessment: Integer candidate selection checks all25 pixels of a5x5 neighborhood and current canvas ownership; source-linked entityHit coverage rejects the historical fractional edge fixture.
Detached command context is computed on a structured clone after the before-state read. Final point and selected-ID checks occur after that expensive work and before ordinary mouse input.

The passive capture listener records lightweight event data; it does not clone, invoke a diagnostic picker or classify commands ahead of the real handler. Wrappers call their actual original once with the same receiver/arguments and preserve its returned value or thrown error. Existing canvas handler is registered before the later bubble cleanup listener.

Existing dispatch/ack/recipient assertion bytes, routes, first batch, policy and app/profile harness remain unchanged. Reuse inventory correctly moves the modified helper/actions out of byte-identical claims and verifies the old clone-only prefix.

gateAssessment.standard: The prior901 explicit1126/parity two-step carry and d889 typecheck carry remain applicable to unchanged production/standard inputs. This is component carry, not a fresh full-check run.
gateAssessment.qa: All88 current focused tests and structural/whitespace receipt hashes verified; they lack the reproduced error-path case.
gateAssessment.build: A fresh build remains required on the repaired final head because added/changed nonignored QA text participates in Tailwind source scanning. Prior901 build does not carry.
gateAssessment.runtime: Not authorized by this source review. Final source/checker/runtime binding and exact parent grant require a new fresh-profile attempt; the closed failed901 profile is not a valid predecessor.

originalFailureScope: This robustness repair does not establish the cause of the earlier failed shrine click. No edge-hit, application regression or timing diagnosis is claimed.
